description: This file defines classes and functions related to test failure analysis in layout tests, including various failure types and logic to determine test results based on failures.

classes.name: TestFailure
classes.description: Abstract base class for representing a test failure, providing serialization methods and comparison operators.

classes.name: FailureTimeout
classes.description: Represents a test failure due to timeout.

classes.name: FailureCrash
classes.description: Represents a test failure due to a crash, with process details.

classes.name: FailureMissingResult
classes.description: Represents a missing expected result failure.

classes.name: FailureTestHarnessAssertion
classes.description: Represents a failure due to an assertion in the test harness.

classes.name: FailureMissingImageHash
classes.description: Represents a missing embedded checksum in expected image.

classes.name: FailureImageHashMismatch
classes.description: Represents an image hash mismatch failure.

classes.name: FailureImageHashIncorrect
classes.description: Represents an incorrect embedded checksum in expected image.

classes.name: FailureReftestMismatch
classes.description: Represents a reference mismatch failure in reftests.

classes.name: FailureReftestMismatchDidNotOccur
classes.description: Represents a failure where a reference mismatch did not occur as expected.

classes.name: FailureReftestNoImagesGenerated
classes.description: Represents a failure where reftest did not generate pixel results.

classes.name: FailureMissingAudio
classes.description: Represents a missing audio result failure.

classes.name: FailureEarlyExit
classes.description: Represents a skipped test due to early exit.

methods.name: is_reftest_failure
methods.description: Checks if any failure in the list is a reftest failure type.

methods.name: determine_result_type
methods.description: Determines the overall test result type based on a list of failures.
